svg.text: BFF + GraphQL hybrid — one REST call out, one federated query in
Mobile client always speaks REST. The BFF either orchestrates 12 service calls by hand (top) or delegates orchestration to
(a) Hand-coded fan-out — BFF maintains 12 service call signatures
BFF speaks gRPC/REST to each service. N call signatures to maintain, N+1 risks, per-call retries, manual error merge.
(b) Federated GraphQL — BFF sends ONE query, gateway resolves all subgraphs
BFF builds one GraphQL query. Gateway plans dependency order, fans out in parallel to all subgraphs, assembles one JSON
